implementation.summary: Terminal cross-target gate. Ran all four machine gates green, recorded the aggregate 547-test figure, read the device's real dpi/size facts off the attached Pixel 8, smoke-tested the desktop app with the measure code in it, and wrote runnable instructions for the four criteria only a human can close. No production code: this task verifies, it does not build.

testRun.output: All BUILD SUCCESSFUL (core-ui in 2m 1s). grep exit 1, no output. Aggregate: data-device-api 100, data-repository-impl 93, presentation-feature-mirror 284 (desktop + iosSimulatorArm64), presentation-core-ui 58, presentation-core-styling 12 = 547 tests, 0 failures.

needsHumanReview.reason: Four DoD clauses need a human at this machine and are recorded BLOCKED, not waived: the light/dark previews rendered by eye (MC-4), the AC-10/11/67/69/71/72 interaction demo on hardware (MC-2, MC-3, MC-5), and the dropped-frame delta read from TransportStats across a freeze-with-dump. Instructions in execution/MANUAL-CHECKS.md.

missingTestsFound: No test asserts the dumpJob cancellation path: a dump still in flight when the frame is released is cancelled in releaseHierarchy(), so a late resolution cannot reduce Ready about a gone frame. Reported honestly by the batch-B implementer and left uncovered.
The design's Math.max(h, 1) neighbour-height floor is unexercised by the oracle: no ELS node has h == 0, so the real fixture cannot reach it.

MeasureReadout.guides endpoint geometry is now asserted (batch-A follow-up), but the ordinary mid-axis guides' sub-pixel rounding is not: the design's mid-y is a real-valued 206.5 on an odd-height target and the implementation truncates to 206, since IntOffset cannot carry half a pixel.
testsAdded: MeasureGateTest — 14 cases, batch C, making the Alt gating and dispatch-edge decisions testable by pulling them out of the composable
MeasureThresholdUnitsTest — 8 cases at 420 dpi, batch-A follow-up, catching that the misalignment bounds were read in raw px
MeasureGuideGeometryTest — 2 cases, batch-A follow-up, pinning the four guides against the design's own H/V helpers

troubleshooting.issue: Earlier stages recorded, on an agent's report, that this host cannot load Skiko - and that claim shaped how several criteria were scoped.
troubleshooting.resolution: Measured and WITHDRAWN. ./gradlew :desktop-application:run loads Skiko, opens a window and runs clean for over 30 seconds with no exceptions. What this session lacks is Screen Recording permission, so screencapture fails with 'could not create image from display'. The blocker is capture, not rendering: a human at this machine needs no extra setup. The clean boot also verifies something no unit test does - Koin resolves the new DumpHierarchyUseCase binding at runtime, which is the one out-of-scope DI edit batch B flagged.

troubleshooting.resolution: Run in full as a backlog item. The generic coverage-gap sweep was separately skipped per the tier; the three gaps found above are recorded in missingTestsFound rather than silently dropped.
